title: 平安集团Michael Guo：险资获准配置香港ETF，如何提升风险回报？

segments.en: So we do see a growth percentage of allocated towards the life insurance asset insurance capitals now being allowed to invest in Hong Kong ETFs. How are you utilizing that new avenue?

segments.en: Well, it actually thanks to the regulator.
This is actually one of the opportunities for us to enhance our risk return profile to making sure that we get a better return with the low volatility.
segments.zh: 这实际上是我们提升风险回报状况的机会之一，确保我们在低波动下获得更好的回报。
